meta_title: Koné Dépou H'lie — Senior Civil Engineering Technician
hero_eyebrow: Senior Civil Engineering Technician — Abidjan, Ivory Coast
hero_subtitle: From land surveying to architectural design — rigorous technical support, from the field to the blueprint.
about_title: A dual expertise: the field and the blueprint.
about_text: Holder of a BTS in Civil Engineering, Public Works track, obtained in 2023, I've built solid practical experience in construction — land surveying, photogrammetric surveys and drone operation. I'm proficient in AutoCAD, Revit, Archicad and Twinmotion for design and modeling, as well as photogrammetric processing with Metashape.
about_quote: Every measurement matters, every plan must hold up on site.
services_title: Seven skills, one standard of precision.
service_1_text: Precise field surveys with theodolite and GPS, for reliable data from the first measurement.
service_2_text: Aerial surveys and data processing, notably via Metashape.
service_3_text: House plans, from initial survey to full 3D modeling.
service_4_text: Technical analysis of existing plans to guide site work and decisions.
service_5_text: Participation in structural calculations and design of structures.
service_6_text: Rigorous oversight of construction execution, from foundation to finishing.
service_7_text: Support for overall site management and team coordination.
clients_title: Tailored support for every player in construction.
projects_title: From the field to the blueprint, in pictures.
project_marina_text: Animated simulation of a housing estate plan with vehicle circulation.
project_house_text: Full 3D modeling, from exterior volume to landscaping.
contact_text: A survey to carry out, a plan to design, a site to monitor? Describe what you need, I'll get back to you quickly.
